recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間的造血組織與脂肪約各半，細胞密度大致正常、結構保留，沒有腫瘤浸潤或纖維化；在低倍下無法判斷紅系前驅細胞是否缺乏，因此 PRCA 的診斷需要高倍或抹片確認紅系缺失與巨大前原紅血球。
features: Low-power core biopsy with preserved architecture and intact bony trabeculae
Cellularity approximately 40-50%, with hematopoietic tissue interspersed among fat spaces
No focal infiltrates, granulomas, or sheets of abnormal cells at this magnification
Individual lineages, including the erythroid compartment, cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows preserved architecture with bony trabeculae and hematopoietic marrow admixed with fat, with an estimated cellularity of approximately 40-50%. No focal lesions, fibrosis, or infiltrative process are identified. Lineage composition cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Assessment for pure red cell aplasia requires higher-power review and aspirate correlation to document markedly reduced erythroid precursors and the presence of giant pronormoblasts with viral inclusions; parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry or PCR would support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a markedly hypocellular marrow with loss of all lineages, whereas this marrow has preserved overall cellularity.
A normal marrow cannot be distinguished at low power, so higher magnification is needed to confirm absent erythroid islands.
These also show selective erythroid aplasia but lack parvovirus inclusions and may show increased CD8+/CD57+ T cells on immunohistochemistry.
